prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 81.7%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 90.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 63.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Interaction Tutorial Screen: Add a dedicated post-onboarding tutorial screen showing interactive demonstrations of how to control, hide, and talk to your desktop pet. (why: Multiple support emails (3 tickets) report confusion after setup about controlling, hiding, or talking to the pet, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Photo Quality Verification Flow: Insert a photo verification step right after photo upload to test and preview image clarity before generating the custom pet. (why: 3 support tickets report custom pet creation failing or looking wrong, contributing to the 36.8% drop-off during adoption.)
2: [home, new_screen] Desktop Display Pre-Launch Diagnostic Screen: Add a desktop rendering diagnostic step before home intro to ensure the overlay layer launches properly above windows. (why: 3 support tickets report pets not appearing on the desktop or the app failing to open properly on initial launch.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Recovery Safety Hint: Display an prominent account hint clarifying that signing into an existing account restores saved pets. (why: 8 support emails (the #1 complaint theme) report missing or reset pets after signing back in with the wrong account.)
4: [home, wait_info] Generation Time Estimate & Progress Tracker: Enable live time estimates and step progress counters on the waiting screen while building pet assets. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s (median 201s) and 18.7% drop-off due to uncertain waiting periods.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Path Reassurance Story Copy: Update story screen text to inform users they can create additional pets or change styles later in settings. (why: Users hesitate on choose_path (mean 514s) fearing their initial choice permanently locks their pet options.)
6: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Grid Selection Layout: Switch the pet selection screen to a clean grid layout displaying all available starter pets in one view. (why: Adoption stage takes a mean 1017s with 36.8% drop-off; a grid view simplifies comparison and speeds up decisions.)
